task: Block scheduler and webhook triggers from running an assistant/workflow moved to a different project than the trigger's project, logging a clear error on mismatch, with scheduler and webhook tests.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the fire-time guard _skipped_for_inactive_owner in cron.py plus the existing webhook project guard (EPMCDME-13996). Neither covers the project-isolation authorization aspect for the scheduler, which has no ownership check at all. belongs_to_project also fails closed and cannot tell a DB error from a real mismatch, so a transient failure could block a legitimate run. The 300 s cache and update_date-gated job registration mean the check must run at fire time. Bumped from M for the authz/project-isolation red flag.
